fact: The Ministry of Planning and Development announced it is building an Integrated Civil Service Management Information System (ICSMIS) for human resources, converting its HR records to an electronic database, with staff training under way.
title: በኢፌዴሪ ኘላንና ልማት ሚኒስቴር ... የተቀናጀ የሰው ሀብት መረጃ አያያዝ እየገነባ መሆኑን አስታወቀ
